key: CHARLOTTE: These flower rings...
en: CHARLOTTE: These flower rings...
ja: シャルロット: この花の輪っか……

key: One, two, three...
en: One, two, three...

key: ... Eight.
en: ... Eight.

key: CHARLOTTE: One, two...
en: CHARLOTTE: One, two...
ja: シャルロット: 1、2……

key: CHARLOTTE: Eight...
en: CHARLOTTE: Eight...
ja: シャルロット: 8……

key: Eight... Sigh.
en: Eight... Sigh.
ja: 8個……はぁ。

key: Laura's been at it again.
en: Laura's been at it again.
ja: ローラ、またやってるんだ。

key: Howdy, stranger.
en: Howdy, stranger.
ja: よう、旅の人。

key: Tell you what, stranger, if you're lookin' to fish, you lucked out!
en: Tell you what, stranger, if you're lookin' to fish, you lucked out!
ja: なあ、旅の人よ、釣りがしたいなら、運がいいぜ!

key: I've been traveling all across Reborn looking for somewhere that the water was good, and there's nothing like this place left!
en: I've been traveling all across Reborn looking for somewhere that the water was good, and there's nothing like this place left!
ja: リボーンじゅうを旅して、いい水場を探し回ってきたが、こんな場所は他にありゃしねえよ!

key: It's even got a little cabin over on the bank.
en: It's even got a little cabin over on the bank.
ja: 岸には小さな小屋まであってな。

key: Nobody's there, so I'm just gonna assume they don't mind me borrowin' it for a bit.
en: Nobody's there, so I'm just gonna assume they don't mind me borrowin' it for a bit.
ja: 誰もいねえから、ちょいと借りても文句は言われねえだろう。

key: Maybe I can pay 'em in fish.
en: Maybe I can pay 'em in fish.
ja: 魚で払ってやりゃいいさ。

key: Oh, howdy partner.
en: Oh, howdy partner.
ja: おう、よう相棒。

key: I remember you from a ways back. You was the one that took my Old Rod, wasn't you?
en: I remember you from a ways back. You was the one that took my Old Rod, wasn't you?
ja: 前に会ったの覚えてるぜ。ボロのつりざおをくれてやったの、お前だったよな?

key: Ever since then, I've been traveling all across Reborn looking for somewhere that the water was good, and lo an' behold, I've finally landed.
en: Ever since then, I've been traveling all across Reborn looking for somewhere that the water was good, and lo an' behold, I've finally landed.
ja: あれ以来、いい水場を探してリボーンじゅうを回ってたが、やっと落ち着けたよ。

key: This place is some kinda peace, and look! It's even got a cabin off on the bank.
en: This place is some kinda peace, and look! It's even got a cabin off on the bank.
ja: ここは何とも言えねえ静けさでな、見ろよ! 岸に小屋まであるんだぜ。

key: Howdy, partner.
en: Howdy, partner.
ja: よう、相棒。

key: You fixin' to do some fishin'?
en: You fixin' to do some fishin'?
ja: 釣りでもする気か?

key: Now say, come again? You were lookin' for bodies at the bottom of the lake?
en: Now say, come again? You were lookin' for bodies at the bottom of the lake?
ja: ん、もう一回言ってくれ? 湖の底で死体を探してたって?

key: Now you listen here, partner.
en: Now you listen here, partner.
ja: いいか、よく聞けよ、相棒。

key: I'm not gonna ask questions no matter what I fish up, so don't you feel the need to kill me off as a witness or nothin'.
en: I'm not gonna ask questions no matter what I fish up, so don't you feel the need to kill me off as a witness or nothin'.
ja: 何を釣り上げようが、オレは何も聞かねえから、口封じにオレを殺す必要なんてねえぞ。

key: Yeah, yeah, I know, you didn't kill no one.
en: Yeah, yeah, I know, you didn't kill no one.
ja: ああ、ああ、わかってるって、誰も殺しちゃいねえんだろ。

key: I get it. That's what they all say.
en: I get it. That's what they all say.
ja: わかってるさ。みんなそう言うもんだ。

key: I'll-- I'll cooperate, don't worry.
en: I'll-- I'll cooperate, don't worry.
ja: 協力……協力するから、心配すんな。

key: But maybe you should know, I saw one of them Whiscash type things-- a real big'un too-- pullin' something around under the surface.
en: But maybe you should know, I saw one of them Whiscash type things-- a real big'un too-- pullin' something around under the surface.
ja: だが知っといた方がいいかもな、あのナマズンみてえなやつ――でかいやつだ――が、水面下で何か引きずってるのを見たぞ。

key: I didn't think much of it at the time, but now that you mention that's what's down there, that musta been what it was.
en: I didn't think much of it at the time, but now that you mention that's what's down there, that musta been what it was.
ja: その時はあんまり気にしなかったが、今お前がそれの話をしてるってことは、それだったんだろうよ。

key: If you're missin' some kinda evidence you need to get back, it's possible that fish done ate it.
en: If you're missin' some kinda evidence you need to get back, it's possible that fish done ate it.
ja: 取り戻さなきゃならねえ証拠があるってんなら、あの魚が食っちまった可能性もあるな。

key: But it ain't gonna be no stroll around the lake to recover.
en: But it ain't gonna be no stroll around the lake to recover.
ja: だが、それを取り戻すのは、湖を散歩するみてえに簡単じゃねえぞ。

key: Here, why don't you take one of my spare rods?
en: Here, why don't you take one of my spare rods?
ja: ほら、予備の釣りざおを一本持ってけ。

key: If you fish up one of those Whiscash, bring it to me and I'll do the dirty work of searchin' it for you.
en: If you fish up one of those Whiscash, bring it to me and I'll do the dirty work of searchin' it for you.
ja: あのナマズンを釣り上げたら、オレんとこに持ってこい、汚れ仕事は代わりにやってやるよ。

key: Fair warning though, there's a lot of Whiscash in this pond, so there's no guarantee we'll ever find it, if indeed that fish swallowed it.
en: Fair warning though, there's a lot of Whiscash in this pond, so there's no guarantee we'll ever find it, if indeed that fish swallowed it.
ja: ただ言っとくが、この池にはナマズンがうじゃうじゃいるから、その魚が本当に飲み込んでたとしても、見つかる保証はねえぞ。

key: Any luck scoungin' up one of them Whiscash from around here?
en: Any luck scoungin' up one of them Whiscash from around here?
ja: この辺で、ナマズンの一匹でも釣れたか?

key: Ain't nothin' to do but keep tryin'.
en: Ain't nothin' to do but keep tryin'.
ja: 試し続けるしかねえな。

key: All right, hand 'er over. If she's got anything of note, I can find it without hurtin' the thing.
en: All right, hand 'er over. If she's got anything of note, I can find it without hurtin' the thing.
ja: よし、渡してくれ。何か特別なもんが入ってるなら、傷つけずに見つけてやるよ。

key: Now, let's see...
en: Now, let's see...
ja: さて、どれどれ……

key: Well, what've we got here?
en: Well, what've we got here?
ja: さて、何が出てくるかな?

key: This wouldn't happen to be what you're looking for, would it?
en: This wouldn't happen to be what you're looking for, would it?
ja: これ、お前が探してたもんじゃねえか?

key: Glad I could help you out.
en: Glad I could help you out.
ja: 力になれて良かったぜ。

key: So that means you can let me live, right?
en: So that means you can let me live, right?
ja: つまり、オレを生かしといてくれるってことだよな?

key: Nope, no dice. Go fish.
en: Nope, no dice. Go fish.
ja: いや、ダメだな。もう一回釣ってこい。

key: There's bound to be a lot of 'em in this lake, and any one of them coulda been the one that chompered it up, so ain't nothin' to do but keep on keepin' on.
en: There's bound to be a lot of 'em in this lake, and any one of them coulda been the one that chompered it up, so ain't nothin' to do but keep on keepin' on.
ja: この湖にはたくさんいるだろうし、そのどれが食っちまったかなんてわからねえから、続けるしかねえな。

key: We'll get 'em eventually, partner.
en: We'll get 'em eventually, partner.
ja: そのうち見つかるさ、相棒。

key: Hey there, partner!
en: Hey there, partner!
ja: よう、相棒!

key: I uh, I don't know nothin' about nothin'. Remember that, all right?
en: I uh, I don't know nothin' about nothin'. Remember that, all right?
ja: オレは、あー、何にも知らねえからな。覚えとけよ?

key: LAURA: Well, this is strange, isn't it?
en: LAURA: Well, this is strange, isn't it?
ja: ローラ: あら、これは変ですね?

key: Um, do try not to trample the flowers though?
en: Um, do try not to trample the flowers though?
ja: あの、お花は踏まないようにしてもらえますか?

key: I've spent quite a bit of time on them.
en: I've spent quite a bit of time on them.
ja: けっこう時間をかけてるので。

key: ANNA: Nostra and I believe in you, \PN!
en: ANNA: Nostra and I believe in you, \PN!
ja: アンナ: ノストラとあたし、あなたを信じてるよ、\PN!

key: ANNA: Nostra and I still believe in you, \PN!
en: ANNA: Nostra and I still believe in you, \PN!
ja: アンナ: ノストラとあたし、まだあなたを信じてるからね、\PN!

key: NOEL: I don't really see the point of doing this just now, but...
en: NOEL: I don't really see the point of doing this just now, but...
ja: ノエル: 今これをやる意味はあんまりないと思うけど……

key: I guess if you're ready, take your place.
en: I guess if you're ready, take your place.
ja: 準備ができてるなら、位置についてくれ。

key: CHARLOTTE: We're really doing this right here, huh.
en: CHARLOTTE: We're really doing this right here, huh.
ja: シャルロット: 本当にここでやるんだ。

key: Sure.
en: Sure.
ja: いいけど。

key: So, this is gonna be a six-on-six Single Battle.
en: So, this is gonna be a six-on-six Single Battle.
ja: それじゃ、これは6対6のシングルバトルになる。

key: Either Trainer is allowed to make--
en: Either Trainer is allowed to make--
ja: どちらのトレーナーも――

key: CHARLOTTE: Saphira!
en: CHARLOTTE: Saphira!
ja: シャルロット: サファイラ!

key: SAPHIRA: Charlotte, you're here!
en: SAPHIRA: Charlotte, you're here!
ja: サファイラ: シャルロット、来てくれたのね!

key: CHARLOTTE: Surprised to see ya, Sis.
en: CHARLOTTE: Surprised to see ya, Sis.
ja: シャルロット: びっくりした、姉さん。

key: SAPHIRA: And Anna, Noel...
en: SAPHIRA: And Anna, Noel...
ja: サファイラ: それに、アンナ、ノエルも……

key: You all escaped.
en: You all escaped.
ja: みんな、脱出したのね。

key: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, \PN and Shelly gave us a hand.
en: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, \PN and Shelly gave us a hand.
ja: シャルロット: うん、\PNとシェリーが手を貸してくれたの。

key: We've gotten away from the Doctor twice already.
en: We've gotten away from the Doctor twice already.
ja: ドクターからは、もう二回も逃げてる。

key: SAPHIRA: We're gonna have to make it three times.
en: SAPHIRA: We're gonna have to make it three times.
ja: サファイラ: 三回目もやらなきゃいけなくなりそうよ。

key: He's coming here.
en: He's coming here.
ja: あいつがここに向かってる。

key: Now.
en: Now.
ja: 今、まさに。

key: And he's not alone.
en: And he's not alone.
ja: それに、一人じゃない。

key: He's got his orderlies and a full squad of men dressed in black with him.
en: He's got his orderlies and a full squad of men dressed in black with him.
ja: 職員たちと、黒ずくめの一団を丸ごと引き連れてる。

key: CHARLOTTE: Team Meteor again.
en: CHARLOTTE: Team Meteor again.
ja: シャルロット: またチームメテオか。

key: SAPHIRA: The group is coming by foot and water both to cut off any escape.
en: SAPHIRA: The group is coming by foot and water both to cut off any escape.
ja: サファイラ: 逃げ道を断つために、陸と水の両方から来てるわ。

key: LAURA: What should we do?
en: LAURA: What should we do?
ja: ローラ: どうしましょう?

key: SAPHIRA: There's only one thing we can do:
en: SAPHIRA: There's only one thing we can do:
ja: サファイラ: できることはひとつだけ:

key: Fight.
en: Fight.
ja: 戦うこと。

key: Listen up.
en: Listen up.
ja: よく聞いて。

key: Charlotte, Anna, Noel, and--
en: Charlotte, Anna, Noel, and--
ja: シャルロット、アンナ、ノエル、それと――

key: Uh, you, other girl.
en: Uh, you, other girl.
ja: ええと、あなた、そこの子。

key: SHELLY: Um-- Um, my name is--
en: SHELLY: Um-- Um, my name is--
ja: シェリー: あの――あの、私の名前は――

key: SAPHIRA: Not now.
en: SAPHIRA: Not now.
ja: サファイラ: 今はいいから。

key: Hurry and get inside, and find somewhere to hide.
en: Hurry and get inside, and find somewhere to hide.
ja: 急いで中に入って、隠れる場所を見つけて。

key: CHARLOTTE: Hello? No way.
en: CHARLOTTE: Hello? No way.
ja: シャルロット: は? 冗談でしょ。

key: I'm not about to run and hide when I can melt their faces off here and now.
en: I'm not about to run and hide when I can melt their faces off here and now.
ja: ここで奴らの顔を溶かせるってのに、逃げて隠れるつもりなんてない。

key: SAPHIRA: Overruled.
en: SAPHIRA: Overruled.
ja: サファイラ: 却下。

key: The Doctor still has potential legal authority over you, since you're not an adult yet.
en: The Doctor still has potential legal authority over you, since you're not an adult yet.
ja: あんたはまだ未成年だから、ドクターにはまだ法的な権限が及ぶ可能性がある。

key: We might be able to resolve the escape charge, but we don't want you to have to deal with resisting arrest too.
en: We might be able to resolve the escape charge, but we don't want you to have to deal with resisting arrest too.
ja: 脱走の件はどうにかできるかもしれないけど、公務執行妨害まで抱え込ませたくないの。

key: So leave this to us.
en: So leave this to us.
ja: だから、ここはあたしたちに任せなさい。

key: \PN, right? And Laura.
en: \PN, right? And Laura.
ja: \PNよね? それとローラ。

key: I'm charging you two with defending the house.
en: I'm charging you two with defending the house.
ja: あんたたち二人には、この家を守る役目を任せる。

key: Anyone gets in, destroy them.
en: Anyone gets in, destroy them.
ja: 誰か入ってきたら、たたきのめして。

key: NOTHING is going to touch my family.
en: NOTHING is going to touch my family.
ja: あたしの家族には、指一本触れさせない。

key: Understand?
en: Understand?
ja: わかった?

key: SAPHIRA: Good.
en: SAPHIRA: Good.
ja: サファイラ: よし。

key: SAPHIRA: The point is, you find where the kids hide in the house and make sure no one else finds it.
en: SAPHIRA: The point is, you find where the kids hide in the house and make sure no one else finds it.
ja: サファイラ: 要するに、子供たちが家のどこに隠れてるか見つけて、他の誰にも見つからないようにすること。

key: Use force if necessary.
en: Use force if necessary.
ja: 必要なら、力を使ってもいい。

key: The Doctor is coming around the long way, but Team Meteor is on the water.
en: The Doctor is coming around the long way, but Team Meteor is on the water.
ja: ドクターは遠回りしてくるけど、チームメテオは水路から来てる。

key: I'm sure they thought they were being clever.
en: I'm sure they thought they were being clever.
ja: 頭がいいつもりなんでしょうけど。

key: But they've made themselves vulnerable.
en: But they've made themselves vulnerable.
ja: でも、それが逆に隙になってる。

key: I'm going ahead; I'll take down as many of them as I can.
en: I'm going ahead; I'll take down as many of them as I can.
ja: あたしは先に行く。できるだけ多く倒してくるから。

key: You all assume your positions.
en: You all assume your positions.
ja: あんたたちは配置についてて。

key: Dragonite, forward!
en: Dragonite, forward!
ja: カイリュー、前へ!

key: CHARLOTTE: So that's our older sister.
en: CHARLOTTE: So that's our older sister.
ja: シャルロット: あれが、あたしたちの姉さんってわけ。

key: Pretty cool, right?
en: Pretty cool, right?
ja: かっこいいでしょ?

key: NOEL: We should hurry.
en: NOEL: We should hurry.
ja: ノエル: 急いだ方がいい。

key: I can see them coming.
en: I can see them coming.
ja: 奴らが来るのが見える。

key: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, okay. Follow her lead!
en: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, okay. Follow her lead!
ja: シャルロット: よし、わかった。姉さんに続いて!

key: Come on, everybody in!
en: Come on, everybody in!
ja: ほら、みんな中へ!

key: NOEL: Okay. Nomos and I are ready whenever you are.
en: NOEL: Okay. Nomos and I are ready whenever you are.
ja: ノエル: わかった。僕とノモスは、いつでも準備できてる。

key: Like before, take your place.
en: Like before, take your place.
ja: 前と同じように、位置についてくれ。

key: SHELLY: Okay, okay. This will be a six-on-six-- Um, it's Singles, right?
en: SHELLY: Okay, okay. This will be a six-on-six-- Um, it's Singles, right?
ja: シェリー: わかった、わかった。これは6対6の――ええと、シングルバトルだよね?

key: Either Trainer can make substitutions, and um...
en: Either Trainer can make substitutions, and um...
ja: どちらのトレーナーも交代ができて、ええと……

key: The battle will end when all six of one Trainer's Pokémon have been knocked out!
en: The battle will end when all six of one Trainer's Pokémon have been knocked out!
ja: 片方のトレーナーの6匹全員が倒れた時点で、バトル終了!

key: NOEL: Well, Nomos, do you think they can do it?
en: NOEL: Well, Nomos, do you think they can do it?
ja: ノエル: さて、ノモス、こいつらならやれると思う?

key: SHELLY: B-begin!
en: SHELLY: B-begin!
ja: シェリー: は、始め!

key: Well, Nomos... I think they're setting a new standard.
en: Well, Nomos... I think they're setting a new standard.
ja: ノモス……この人たちが　新しい基準を　作っているんだと　思います

key: ANNA: Yay!! Great job, \PN!
en: ANNA: Yay!! Great job, \PN!
ja: アンナ: やったー!! すごいよ、\PN!

key: Although, isn't it a little insensitive to win by starting a fire? I mean...
en: Although, isn't it a little insensitive to win by starting a fire? I mean...
ja: でも、火を放って勝つのって、ちょっと無神経じゃない? っていうか……

key: I guess as long as Charlotte and Laura don't find out?
en: I guess as long as Charlotte and Laura don't find out?
ja: シャルロットとローラにバレなければ、いいのかな?

key: It's okay! I won't tell them!
en: It's okay! I won't tell them!
ja: 大丈夫! 言わないでおくから!

key: And Nostra says scorched earth is negligible on the overworld anyway... whatever that means!
en: And Nostra says scorched earth is negligible on the overworld anyway... whatever that means!
ja: それに、ノストラが言うには、フィールド上では焼け跡なんて誤差の範囲だって……何のことかわかんないけど!

key: NOEL: In accordance with official Reborn League policy, I present to you the Standard Badge.
en: NOEL: In accordance with official Reborn League policy, I present to you the Standard Badge.
ja: ノエル: リボーンリーグの公式規定に従い、これをスタンダードバッジとして授与する。

key: \PN received the Standard Badge!
en: \PN received the Standard Badge!
ja: \PNはスタンダードバッジを受け取った!

key: NOEL: By having the Standard Badge, Pokémon up to level 60 obey.
en: NOEL: By having the Standard Badge, Pokémon up to level 60 obey.
ja: ノエル: スタンダードバッジを持っていると、レベル60までのポケモンが言うことを聞くようになる。

key: Additionally, I'm supposed to give you this.
en: Additionally, I'm supposed to give you this.
ja: それと、これも渡すことになっている。

key: NOEL: I'm sure you know, but Hidden Power's type changes based on the Pokémon using it.
en: NOEL: I'm sure you know, but Hidden Power's type changes based on the Pokémon using it.
ja: ノエル: 知っているとは思うけど、めざめるパワーのタイプは、使うポケモンによって変わる。

key: It's useful to unlock inner potential... and stuff.
en: It's useful to unlock inner potential... and stuff.
ja: 内に秘めた可能性を引き出すのに役立つ……とか、そういうものだ。

key: That's all, right?
en: That's all, right?
ja: これで全部、だよね?

key: LAURA: ........Did I miss something?
en: LAURA: ........Did I miss something?
ja: ローラ: ……何か見逃してしまいましたか?

key: ANNA: \PN just beat Noel for a Badge!
en: ANNA: \PN just beat Noel for a Badge!
ja: アンナ: \PNがノエルを倒して、バッジをもらったの!

key: SHELLY: How is Charlotte?
en: SHELLY: How is Charlotte?
ja: シェリー: シャルロットは、大丈夫?

key: LAURA: She's fine, but I think she needs some time alone right now.
en: LAURA: She's fine, but I think she needs some time alone right now.
ja: ローラ: 大丈夫ですけど、今は少し一人にしてあげた方がいいと思います。

key: ANNA: Can you tell us what really happened?
en: ANNA: Can you tell us what really happened?
ja: アンナ: 本当は何があったのか、教えてもらえる?

key: LAURA: Um, well........
en: LAURA: Um, well........
ja: ローラ: ええと、その……

key: It was a long time ago, but when Charlotte was very young, there was an accident.
en: It was a long time ago, but when Charlotte was very young, there was an accident.
ja: ずっと昔、シャルロットがまだ幼い頃、ある事故があったんです。

key: Back then, we all lived together.
en: Back then, we all lived together.
ja: あの頃は、みんな一緒に暮らしていて。

key: Charlotte, Saphira and I, and Mom and Dad.
en: Charlotte, Saphira and I, and Mom and Dad.
ja: シャルロットと、サファイラと、わたし、それにお父さんとお母さんと。

key: She would sneak out late every night, usually just to play in the garden or stare out at the lake.
en: She would sneak out late every night, usually just to play in the garden or stare out at the lake.
ja: シャルロットは毎晩こっそり抜け出して、たいていは庭で遊んだり、湖を眺めたりしていました。

key: Nothing harmful.
en: Nothing harmful.
ja: 特に害のあることじゃなくて。

key: And that was fine, because it was safe here.
en: And that was fine, because it was safe here.
ja: ここは安全だったから、それで問題なかったんです。

key: But one night, she was playing with her Vulpix and........
en: But one night, she was playing with her Vulpix and........
ja: でも、ある夜、ロコンと遊んでいて……

key: As you can see, it's easy for a fire to spread in a place like this........
en: As you can see, it's easy for a fire to spread in a place like this........
ja: 見ての通り、こういう場所では火はあっという間に燃え広がってしまって……

key: Saphira woke me up and rushed me out of the house just in time, but our parents didn't make it.
en: Saphira woke me up and rushed me out of the house just in time, but our parents didn't make it.
ja: サファイラがわたしを起こして、間一髪で家の外に連れ出してくれたんですけど、両親は助かりませんでした。

key: Ever since then, it's just been Saphira looking out for us........
en: Ever since then, it's just been Saphira looking out for us........
ja: それ以来、ずっとサファイラがわたしたちの面倒を見てくれていて……

key: Especially after the Doctor took us in.
en: Especially after the Doctor took us in.
ja: 特に、ドクターがわたしたちを引き取ってからは。

key: She's kept us safe for years.
en: She's kept us safe for years.
ja: 何年も、わたしたちを守ってくれています。

key: I really hope Charlotte's okay.
en: I really hope Charlotte's okay.
ja: シャルロットが無事だといいんですけど。

key: I don't know what I'd do if she--
en: I don't know what I'd do if she--
ja: もし、あの子が――

key: If she were........
en: If she were........
ja: もし、あの子がもし……

key: I'm sorry, I shouldn't cry.
en: I'm sorry, I shouldn't cry.
ja: ごめんなさい、泣くべきじゃないのに。

key: I should be strong like Saphira........
en: I should be strong like Saphira........
ja: サファイラみたいに強くならないと……

key: ANNA: No, it's okay!
en: ANNA: No, it's okay!
ja: アンナ: ううん、大丈夫だよ!

key: Cry all you need!
en: Cry all you need!
ja: 泣きたいだけ泣いていいの!

key: Tears are just one way of getting sadness out of the body.
en: Tears are just one way of getting sadness out of the body.
ja: 涙って、体から悲しみを追い出す方法のひとつなんだから。

key: C'mon, let's go inside, okay?
en: C'mon, let's go inside, okay?
ja: さ、中に入ろう、ね?

key: Nostra says you'll feel better if you have a snack and sit down.
en: Nostra says you'll feel better if you have a snack and sit down.
ja: ノストラも、おやつを食べて座れば、気分が良くなるって言ってるよ。

key: LAURA: All right........
en: LAURA: All right........
ja: ローラ: わかりました……

key: CHARLOTTE: Looks like I'll be refereeing this one.
en: CHARLOTTE: Looks like I'll be refereeing this one.
ja: シャルロット: これは、あたしが審判やることになりそうね。

key: If only to make sure nothing gets out of hand...
en: If only to make sure nothing gets out of hand...
ja: 何事も収拾つかなくならないようにね……

key: Does it really have to be here?
en: Does it really have to be here?
ja: 本当にここでやる必要あるの?

key: ...Whatever.
en: ...Whatever.
ja: ……まあ、いいけど。

key: If you're ready, tell Noel.
en: If you're ready, tell Noel.
ja: 準備ができたら、ノエルに言って。

key: SHELLY: I guess-- I guess I'll be refereeing this one?
en: SHELLY: I guess-- I guess I'll be refereeing this one?
ja: シェリー: え、えっと……これ、私が審判やるってこと?

key: SHELLY: Hehe, I get to see another one of your Gym Battles.
en: SHELLY: Hehe, I get to see another one of your Gym Battles.
ja: シェリー: えへへ、また別のジムバトルが見られるんだね。

key: Hey, hey, \PN, you'll rematch me someday, right, okay?
en: Hey, hey, \PN, you'll rematch me someday, right, okay?
ja: ねえねえ、\PN、いつか私ともまた対戦してくれるよね、ね?

key: CHARLOTTE: ...
en: CHARLOTTE: ...
ja: シャルロット: ……

key: CHARLOTTE: It wasn't our fault.
en: CHARLOTTE: It wasn't our fault.
ja: シャルロット: あたしたちのせいじゃなかった。

key: It's easier to say than feel, but being here helps.
en: It's easier to say than feel, but being here helps.
ja: 感じるより言う方が簡単だけど、ここにいると少し楽になる。

key: Easier to feel like I deserve to be.
en: Easier to feel like I deserve to be.
ja: ここにいる資格があるって、感じやすくなる。

key: It wasn't your fault.
en: It wasn't your fault.
ja: あんたのせいでもなかった。

key: CHARLOTTE: Anyway, enough brooding.
en: CHARLOTTE: Anyway, enough brooding.
ja: シャルロット: とにかく、うじうじするのはもう終わり。

key: I wanted to show you our new friend.
en: I wanted to show you our new friend.
ja: あたしたちの新しい仲間を見せたかったの。

key: CHARLOTTE: This one started following me around the Grand Hall last time I was there.
en: CHARLOTTE: This one started following me around the Grand Hall last time I was there.
ja: シャルロット: 前にグランドホールに行った時、こいつがついてくるようになって。

key: CHARLOTTE: This one kept following me around...
en: CHARLOTTE: This one kept following me around...
ja: シャルロット: こいつ、ずっとついてきちゃって……

key: So, she's mine now.
en: So, she's mine now.
ja: それで、今はあたしのものってわけ。

key: I figure it might not hurt to start branching out into other types.
en: I figure it might not hurt to start branching out into other types.
ja: 他のタイプにも手を広げてみるのも、悪くないかなって。

key: ...And Vulpix is still cute.
en: ...And Vulpix is still cute.
ja: ……それに、ロコンはやっぱりかわいいし。

key: VULPIX: Pix!
en: VULPIX: Pix!
ja: ロコン: ロコ!

key: NINETALES: ...Tai!
en: NINETALES: ...Tai!
ja: キュウコン: ……キュウ!

key: VULPIX: Pixpix!
en: VULPIX: Pixpix!
ja: ロコン: ロコロコ!

key: CHARLOTTE: ...Good.
en: CHARLOTTE: ...Good.
ja: シャルロット: ……いい子。

key: CHARLOTTE: All right, wrecking ball.
en: CHARLOTTE: All right, wrecking ball.
ja: シャルロット: よし、破壊野郎。

key: Fight me.
en: Fight me.
ja: かかってきなよ。

key: Fire Types or not, I plan on shooting up in rank.
en: Fire Types or not, I plan on shooting up in rank.
ja: ほのおタイプだろうと何だろうと、あたしはランクを駆け上がるつもりだから。

key: And if I can trust myself to go all out here, then I can trust myself anywhere.
en: And if I can trust myself to go all out here, then I can trust myself anywhere.
ja: ここで全力を出せるって自分を信じられれば、どこででも信じられる。

key: After all, true beauty is in having control!
en: After all, true beauty is in having control!
ja: だって、本当の美しさは、自分を制御できてこそなんだから!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
